Seat: domain:spec#1

**Declared file surface**: `packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, plus their tests and a `.changeset/` entry if published bytes move.

**Intersection with the one `pm:dispatched` card of this lane — EMPTY.** objectui#9717 (PR objectui#9724) is in `scripts/` (`check-doc-component-types.mjs`, `check-registry-bare-name-collisions.mjs`, `scripts/__tests__/`). ⛔ Nothing in `packages/plugin-grid`. Re-take against the live PR before writing.

⚠️ **The one thing this card must establish before it repairs anything**, and it is named in the card: the two `as any` casts at `ObjectGrid.tsx:5328` and `:4720` are ⛔ **NOT MEASURED** as to what else they are paying for. `BulkActionDialog`'s `dataSource` prop is an **intersection** — `BulkExecutorOptions['dataSource'] & { find?, findOne?, … }` — so a cast may be carrying a member unrelated to the bulk doors. ⭐ Deleting a cast to make one claim true, and thereby erasing a different check, is this defect committed a second time. **Establish what each cast is for, then repair.**

⚠️ The mechanism, so it is not re-derived from scratch: both members use **property syntax** (`bulkUpdate?: (…) => …`), so `strictFunctionTypes` checks their parameters **contravariantly** — a door narrowed to `ReadonlyArray<string>` ⛔ cannot stand in for a slot demanding `ReadonlyArray<string | number>`. That is why the cast is load-bearing and not incidental.

⛔ Stop conditions: if the honest repair turns out to **widen or narrow a published accept set**, that is `Clause-②: yes` — stop and hand back rather than declaring it. And ⛔ do not "fix" this by re-widening `DataSource` — objectui#9511's ruling B narrowed those doors deliberately and is maintainer-adopted.

⚠️ An **optionality** gap, ⛔ NOT MEASURED as reachable and therefore ⛔ not filed: `ObjectGrid` declares `dataSource` **optional**, while `BulkExecutorOptions` and `BulkActionDialogProps` demand one and the executor dereferences `dataSource.update` / `.delete` unconditionally — and neither `setActiveBulkDef` path gates on its presence. ⭐ The zero is the load-bearing half, not a formality: had that file carried the **dispatching** session's requests it would necessarily also carry that session's own stamps, which are **not** at tier. Their complete absence is what establishes the file is the sub-agent's own request stream and nothing else.

## ⚠️ And the reviewer refused to certify its own tier — correctly

It reported plainly what it was **TOLD** versus what it **MEASURED**: it called `get_session`, which returned `configured_model` at tier but `session_context.model`, `last_served_model` and `user_switched_model` all reading a **different** model. ⇒ it concluded that tool describes the **dispatching session**, ⛔ not itself, per `references/contract-review.md` — 「`get_session` 量的是派发会话,⛔ 不作互证」 — and therefore wrote **no `N/M` stamp control**, because it had measured none.

⭐ That is the right refusal, and it is why the rule puts the reading on the **adopting** seat: a sub-agent has no instrument to measure its own served model, so a self-reported tier is worth nothing and an honest reviewer says so instead of filling the line. ⚠️ Had it copied the `configured_model` it was told, the line would have read correct and certified nothing.

## What the review settled, beyond PASS

⭐ The `Clause-②: yes` on this card is **the rule-prescribed conservative arm, ⛔ not a fact about the contract.** Measured by the reviewer on the **published 17.6.0 tarball** — not a local build:

- `exports` addresses only `.`
- a closure walk of `dist/index.d.ts` over relative imports reaches **18** `.d.ts` files and excludes **both** `hooks/useBulkExecutor.d.ts` and `components/BulkActionDialog.d.ts` (lit members `ObjectGrid.d.ts`, `BulkActionBar.d.ts` in; absent probe out)
- out-of-package consumers: **0** (lit control: 9 / 13 / 5 files in-package)

⇒ **nothing on a published surface moves**, and ⭐ **this review is the whole cost of the `yes`**. The declaration stands as filed — re-posting `no` would need a `Contract-text:` and buys nothing now that the review is spent.

⚠️ ⛔ But that reading is exactly the **precedent** this seat declined to set inside a p2 bug fix, and the reviewer agrees it deserves its own card. ## ⭐ The one probe that needed disambiguating — and why the naive reading was wrong

The erasing cast read **2 → 1** package-wide, which looks like one survivor. It is not. The surviving occurrence is not a cast at all: it is the string literal `ERASING_CAST` at `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts:134`, i.e. **the new pin spelling out the thing it forbids**.

⇒ **A count is invariant under quotation**, so the phrase had to be probed in its two positions separately:

| position | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| **assertion position** — `dataSource={dataSource as any}` inside `ObjectGrid.tsx` | **2** | **0** |
| **quoted** — the same bytes inside the new pin | **0** | **1** |
| **[LIT CTRL]** `dataSource={` — any hand-off at all in `ObjectGrid.tsx` | **2** | **2** |

The lit control is the one that makes the zero mean something: **both** hand-offs still exist and still pass a `dataSource`; what left the file is the erasure, not the prop. ⇒ 2 → 0 is a repair, not a deletion.

## What landed, and what deliberately did not

The structural face `BulkExecutorOptions.dataSource` no longer **restates** `DataSource`'s bulk methods with the pre-narrowing union — it is **derived** from `DataSource` itself, so the two can no longer drift apart in silence. Both `as any` hand-offs in `ObjectGrid.tsx` are gone: the `RecordDetailPanel` one removed outright, the `BulkActionDialog` one replaced by a non-null assertion.

⚠️ **Carried forward, ⛔ NOT fixed by this PR**, and recorded here so the next reader of that file does not mistake it for an oversight: `BulkActionDialogProps.dataSource` still **restates** `findOne` with `id: string | number`.
